secoes.titulo: Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência
Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões
Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão
Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem
Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below:
"Remote work has not eliminated office politics; it has merely relocated them to digital channels. Employees who once competed for corner offices now vie for visibility in video calls and instant messaging threads, often working late into the night just to appear responsive."

According to the passage, remote work has caused employees to
alternativas: abandon career competition in favor of personal well-being.
adapt their competitive behaviors to online environments.
demand physical corner offices when visiting company headquarters.
reduce their total working hours by using instant messaging.
refuse to participate in video calls outside regular business hours.
questoes.explicacao: O texto afirma que a disputa profissional migrou para canais digitais, onde funcionários buscam visibilidade em chamadas de vídeo e mensagens. As demais opções contradizem o trecho ao sugerirem fim da competição, recusa a chamadas, redução de jornada ou exigência de salas físicas.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the passage below:
"While desalination plants offer a reliable water supply for arid coastal cities, their high energy consumption and the disposal of concentrated brine back into the ocean pose severe environmental challenges that engineers have yet to fully resolve."

What can be inferred from the passage about desalination technology?
alternativas: It currently solves water scarcity at an environmental cost.
It has already become completely harmless to marine ecosystems.
It is restricted to inland cities with abundant solar power.
It fails to provide a predictable volume of potable water.
It eliminates the need for specialized engineering research.
questoes.explicacao: O trecho mostra que as usinas garantem água confiável para regiões costeiras áridas, mas geram alto consumo de energia e descarte de salmoura no oceano. As outras opções erram ao negar a eficácia hídrica, situar as usinas no interior ou dizer que o impacto ambiental já foi resolvido.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the text below:
"Urban tree canopies do more than beautify neighborhoods. Studies show that streets lined with mature trees can be up to five degrees cooler in summer than bare asphalt avenues, directly reducing household air-conditioning expenses and heat-related illnesses."

The text explicitly states that mature street trees contribute to
alternativas: higher municipal road maintenance budgets during summer.
an increase in local property taxes for homeowners.
the complete replacement of residential cooling appliances.
lower domestic spending on artificial cooling.
frequent damage to underground electrical cables.
questoes.explicacao: O texto afirma explicitamente que ruas arborizadas são mais frescas e reduzem diretamente os gastos domésticos com ar-condicionado. As demais alternativas trazem informações ausentes ou distorcidas sobre impostos, danos a cabos, manutenção viária ou substituição total de aparelhos.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below:
"For decades, corporate training relied on day-long workshops packed with slides. Today, instructional designers favor microlearning—short, focused modules lasting under ten minutes that staff can complete between tasks, leading to higher retention rates."

Based on the text, traditional day-long workshops are viewed in comparison to microlearning as
alternativas: more flexible for employees with busy daily schedules.
entirely devoid of visual aids such as slide presentations.
the newest trend adopted by modern instructional designers.
shorter than ten minutes when split into daily tasks.
less effective at helping workers retain information.
questoes.explicacao: Como o microlearning gera maiores taxas de retenção do que os treinamentos antigos de dia inteiro, infere-se que o formato tradicional retém menos conteúdo. As outras opções invertem a cronologia, negam o uso de slides citado no texto ou atribuem flexibilidade e curta duração ao modelo antigo.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the brief report:
"Global lithium prices fell sharply last year after new mines in South America and Australia ramped up output faster than electric vehicle sales grew. However, analysts warn that this surplus is temporary and may discourage investments needed for the next decade."

Why did lithium prices drop last year?
alternativas: Electric vehicle sales stopped completely across global markets.
Mining companies in Australia closed their primary facilities.
Supply expanded more rapidly than demand from the EV sector.
Analysts convinced investors to sell all battery metal stocks.
Governments banned lithium extraction in South America.
questoes.explicacao: O texto explica que a queda de preços ocorreu porque a produção de novas minas cresceu mais rápido que as vendas de veículos elétricos, gerando excedente. As outras opções inventam proibições governamentais, fechamento de minas ou parada total nas vendas de carros elétricos.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the passage below:
"Although automated translation tools handle routine business correspondence remarkably well, nuances in legal contracts and diplomatic treaties still require human translators who understand cultural subtext and institutional history."

The author implies that automated translation tools
alternativas: are useless for everyday corporate emails and memos.
have completely replaced human professionals in diplomacy.
always outperform human experts when analyzing legal contracts.
lack a deep grasp of cultural context and historical nuance.
were originally designed exclusively for diplomatic treaties.
questoes.explicacao: Ao afirmar que contratos e tratados ainda exigem humanos capazes de compreender subtexto cultural e história institucional, o autor implica que as ferramentas automáticas não dominam essas nuances. As demais opções contradizem o bom uso rotineiro ou exageram a substituição de humanos.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below:
"Public libraries have evolved from quiet repositories of printed books into vibrant community hubs offering free internet access, digital literacy classes, and coworking spaces for small business owners."

When scanning the text for specific services offered to entrepreneurs, the reader identifies the provision of
alternativas: shared workspaces.
direct financial loans.
accounting software licenses.
private legal representation.
printed marketing catalogs.
questoes.explicacao: A leitura localizada identifica 'coworking spaces for small business owners', o que corresponde a espaços de trabalho compartilhados para pequenos empresários. As outras alternativas citam empréstimos, licenças contábeis, assessoria jurídica e catálogos impressos que não constam no trecho.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the note below:
"Consumers often assume that biodegradable plastics break down quickly in any environment. In reality, most require industrial composting facilities operating at temperatures above 55°C; left in the ocean, they persist nearly as long as conventional polymers."

What misconception do consumers hold regarding biodegradable plastics?
alternativas: That they can only be processed inside industrial furnaces.
That they decompose rapidly under ordinary natural conditions.
That they are more durable than conventional plastics in water.
That they require temperatures above 55°C to be manufactured.
That they are banned from industrial composting facilities.
questoes.explicacao: O primeiro período mostra o equívoco dos consumidores: acreditar que plásticos biodegradáveis se decompõem rapidamente em qualquer ambiente natural. As demais opções confundem a condição real de compostagem industrial a 55°C com o mito popular ou distorcem a durabilidade na água.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the sentence below:
"The central bank decided to **postpone** the release of the quarterly inflation report until all regional data could be verified, as the initial figures were **actually** incomplete."

The highlighted words **postpone** and **actually** mean, respectively,
alternativas: cancel and currently.
anticipate and nowadays.
publish and theoretically.
confirm and presently.
delay and in fact.
questoes.explicacao: 'Postpone' significa adiar ('delay') e o falso cognato 'actually' significa de fato ou na verdade ('in fact'), e não atualmente. As demais opções trazem traduções incorretas como cancelar, antecipar, publicar ou confundem 'actually' com 'currently' e 'nowadays'.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below:
"After months of intense negotiations, the two software companies finally **called it a day** and signed a mutually beneficial licensing agreement before the end of the fiscal quarter."

Wait—review the sentence below instead:
"When the power grid failed for the third time that afternoon, the laboratory technicians decided to **call it a day** and secure all chemical samples until the following morning."

In this context, the expression **call it a day** means to
alternativas: stop working for the rest of the day.
celebrate an unexpected scientific discovery.
schedule an emergency daytime meeting.
work overtime throughout the night.
file a formal complaint against the utility company.
questoes.explicacao: A expressão idiomática 'call it a day' significa encerrar o expediente ou parar de trabalhar pelo resto do dia, confirmada pelo ato de guardar as amostras até a manhã seguinte. As demais opções inventam comemorações, reuniões, horas extras noturnas ou reclamações formais.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the passage below:
"The external auditor noticed a **Comprehensive** list of safety protocols in the refinery manual, ensuring that every potential hazard was thoroughly addressed from initial drilling to final transport."

In the sentence above, the word **Comprehensive** is closest in meaning to
alternativas: easy to understand.
sympathetic and kind.
complete and broad in scope.
brief and simplified.
optional for new employees.
questoes.explicacao: 'Comprehensive' é um falso cognato que significa abrangente, completo ou exaustivo ('complete and broad in scope'), confirmado por cobrir todos os riscos possíveis. Não significa compreensivo/empático ('sympathetic') nem fácil de entender ('understandable'), breve ou opcional.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below:
"Although the startup's new payment app gained thousands of users in its first week, the chief technology officer warned against **cutting corners** during cybersecurity testing."

By warning against **cutting corners**, the officer wants the team to avoid
alternativas: redesigning the geometric icons on the user interface.
expanding the app to international markets too early.
hiring external consultants to review the source code.
sacrificing quality to save time or money.
charging customers higher fees for instant transfers.
questoes.explicacao: A expressão 'cut corners' significa fazer algo de forma malfeita ou pular etapas importantes para economizar tempo ou dinheiro, comprometendo a qualidade. As outras opções fazem leitura literal de 'corners' (cantos/ícones) ou inventam expansão internacional e cobrança de taxas.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the sentence below:
"Only candidates with sharp **ingenuity** and proven leadership were selected to spearhead the renewable energy transition project."

In this context, the noun **ingenuity** refers to
alternativas: naivety and lack of malice.
creativity and inventiveness.
strict obedience to hierarchy.
financial wealth and assets.
academic honesty in exams.
questoes.explicacao: 'Ingenuity' é um falso cognato clássico que significa engenhosidade, criatividade e capacidade inventiva ('creativity and inventiveness'), qualidade desejável para liderar projetos inovadores. Não significa ingenuidade ('naivety'), obediência estrita, riqueza ou honestidade acadêmica.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the passage below:
"The logistics coordinator had to **come up with** a contingency route within two hours after a landslide blocked the main highway leading to the port."

The phrasal verb **come up with** can be replaced, without change in meaning, by
alternativas: postpone.
abandon.
criticize.
inspect.
devise.
questoes.explicacao: O phrasal verb 'come up with' significa criar, elaborar ou encontrar uma solução ou plano, sendo sinônimo direto de 'devise'. As demais opções ('postpone' adiar, 'abandon' abandonar, 'criticize' criticar, 'inspect' inspecionar) alteram completamente o sentido da frase.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the statement below:
"The pharmaceutical company issued a **tentative** schedule for the clinical trials, noting that dates could shift depending on regulatory approval."

The word **tentative** indicates that the schedule is
alternativas: provisional and subject to change.
final and legally binding.
ambitious and impossible to meet.
repetitive and poorly organized.
secret and restricted to executives.
questoes.explicacao: Em inglês, 'tentative' aplicada a cronogramas ou planos significa provisório, preliminar, sujeito a alterações ('provisional and subject to change'), como confirma a oração seguinte. As outras opções erram ao sugerir caráter definitivo, impossível, repetitivo ou secreto.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below:
"Because raw materials were scarce throughout the quarter, the manufacturing plant operated **from hand to mouth**, ordering just enough steel to fulfill each week's urgent contracts."

Operating **from hand to mouth** means that the plant was
alternativas: manufacturing goods exclusively through manual labor.
generating record profits from high-margin steel contracts.
Barely meeting immediate needs without building reserves.
distributing free promotional samples directly to consumers.
negotiating verbal agreements without written documentation.
questoes.explicacao: A expressão 'from hand to mouth' significa viver ou operar no limite, suprindo apenas as necessidades imediatas sem formar estoque ou reserva, exatamente como descrito no trecho. As demais opções interpretam literalmente 'hand' ou 'mouth' ou inventam lucros recordes.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the sentence below:
"Had the municipality upgraded its drainage infrastructure ten years ago, last month's heavy rains **would not have flooded** the commercial district."

The grammatical structure used in this sentence expresses a
alternativas: habitual action that occurred every summer in the past.
future prediction with a high probability of happening.
formal request directed at the city engineering department.
hypothetical past condition whose outcome cannot be changed.
present obligation that citizens must immediately fulfill.
questoes.explicacao: A inversão 'Had the municipality upgraded' seguida de 'would not have flooded' forma a Third Conditional, usada para expressar uma condição hipotética no passado contrária aos fatos reais (a cidade não atualizou a drenagem e o distrito inundou). As demais opções confundem o tempo e o modo verbal.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below:
"Over the past five years, coastal wind farms **have supplied** nearly thirty percent of the region's electricity, and three additional turbines are currently under construction."

The verb form **have supplied** (Present Perfect) is used here because the action
alternativas: started in the past and continues to be relevant up to the present.
took place at a single, finished moment in the distant past.
will only begin after the three new turbines are completed.
represents an unreal wish expressed by energy regulators.
describes a temporary event that ended five years ago.
questoes.explicacao: O Present Perfect ('have supplied') acompanhado de 'Over the past five years' indica uma ação iniciada no passado que se estende e mantém relevância até o momento presente. As outras opções descrevem o passado simples concluído, o futuro ou uma hipótese irreal.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the passage below:
"When the server crashed at midnight, the backup system failed to activate automatically. **Consequently**, the IT team had to restore the database manually before markets opened."

The discourse marker **Consequently** establishes a relationship of
alternativas: concession.
contrast.
cause and effect.
condition.
comparison.
questoes.explicacao: O conector 'Consequently' (consequentemente/portanto) introduz o resultado ou efeito direto da falha simultânea do servidor e do sistema de backup. As demais opções indicam concessão, contraste, condição ou comparação, relações que não correspondem ao valor semântico do termo.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the policy statement below:
"Visitors **may** use the corporate cafeteria between 11:30 a.m. and 2:00 p.m., provided they are accompanied by a registered staff member."

In this sentence, the modal verb **may** conveys the idea of
alternativas: strict prohibition.
past ability.
inevitable certainty.
moral obligation.
permission.
questoes.explicacao: Em normas administrativas, o modal 'may' indica permissão ('Visitors are allowed to use'), condicionada no trecho ao acompanhamento por um funcionário. As outras alternativas atribuem valores incompatíveis como proibição estrita, habilidade passada, certeza inevitável ou obrigação moral.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below:
"Microgrids allow hospitals and emergency shelters to disconnect from the main power network during storms so that **they** can continue operating independently on local solar batteries."

The pronoun **they** refers to
alternativas: storms.
hospitals and emergency shelters.
local solar batteries.
power networks.
weather forecasters.
questoes.explicacao: Pela coesão referencial e pelo sentido da oração, 'they' retoma 'hospitals and emergency shelters', que são as instituições capazes de continuar operando de modo independente com baterias solares durante tempestades. As demais opções apontam referentes sem sentido lógico como sujeito de 'operating'.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the sentence below:
"**Unless** the contractor submits the environmental impact assessment by Friday, the municipal council will suspend the building permit."

The conjunction **Unless** introduces the same logical condition as
alternativas: Because the contractor submits.
As soon as the contractor submits.
Even after the contractor submits.
If the contractor does not submit.
Since the contractor has submitted.
questoes.explicacao: A conjunção condicional negativa 'Unless' significa 'a menos que' ou 'se não', equivalendo gramatical e semanticamente a 'If the contractor does not submit'. As outras opções expressam causa ('Because'/'Since'), tempo ('As soon as') ou concessão temporal ('Even after').

questoes.enunciado:
Read the technical observation:
"The pressure valve was completely corroded and covered in mineral deposits; the maintenance crew **must have ignored** the monthly inspection checklist for at least a year."

The structure **must have ignored** expresses a
alternativas: future duty assigned to the maintenance crew.
strong logical deduction about a past event.
polite suggestion for improving future inspections.
formal permission granted by the plant supervisor.
habitual routine performed safely every month.
questoes.explicacao: A estrutura modal 'must have + particípio passado' é usada para expressar uma dedução lógica quase certa ou conclusão forte sobre algo ocorrido no passado, baseada na evidência da válvula corroída. Não expressa obrigação futura, sugestão, permissão nem rotina segura.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the passage below:
"**Whereas** traditional supply chains prioritize the lowest possible unit cost through single-source suppliers, resilient supply chains invest in geographic diversification to prevent bottlenecks."

The word **Whereas** is used at the beginning of the sentence to
alternativas: contrast two different approaches to supply chain management.
indicate the physical location where goods are manufactured.
list chronological steps in a warehouse inventory audit.
demonstrate that both models share identical financial goals.
explain the historical origin of single-source suppliers.
questoes.explicacao: A conjunção 'Whereas' (enquanto que / ao passo que) estabelece um contraste direto entre duas abordagens distintas: a cadeia tradicional focada em custo mínimo e a resiliente focada em diversificação geográfica. As outras opções confundem com lugar ('where'), cronologia, semelhança ou origem histórica.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the passage below:
"Every minute, the equivalent of a garbage truck full of plastic is dumped into our oceans, choking marine life and infiltrating the food chain from plankton to human dinner plates. How many more warning signs do we need before manufacturers are held accountable for the packaging they produce?"

The predominant tone and primary purpose of this passage are, respectively,
alternativas: nostalgic and to narrate the history of commercial fishing.
humorous and to entertain readers with marine trivia.
indifferent and to catalog plastic polymers by weight.
apologetic and to defend packaging manufacturers from fines.
urgent and to persuade readers of the need for corporate accountability.
questoes.explicacao: O uso de imagens fortes ('choking marine life') e da pergunta retórica final cria um tom urgente e crítico, cujo propósito é persuadir o leitor sobre a responsabilização dos fabricantes. As demais opções citam tons incompatíveis como nostálgico, humorístico, indiferente ou apologético.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below:
"During the economic boom, cheap credit was the oxygen that kept zombie companies alive; once interest rates rose, however, that vital supply was abruptly cut off."

By calling cheap credit "the oxygen that kept zombie companies alive," the author uses a
alternativas: literal medical report on workplace air quality.
euphemism to hide the existence of interest rates.
metaphor to emphasize how essential cheap credit was for their survival.
paradox to prove that bankrupt firms never borrow money.
hyperbole to show that banks physically manufacture oxygen.
questoes.explicacao: Comparar implicitamente o crédito barato ao oxigênio que mantém empresas vivas configura uma metáfora, usada para destacar que o financiamento a juros baixos era vital para a sobrevivência delas. Não se trata de relato médico literal, eufemismo, paradoxo ou fabricação física de gás.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the paragraph below:
"First, raw cocoa beans are harvested and fermented under banana leaves for several days. Next, they are spread out on wooden mats to dry under the tropical sun. Finally, the dried beans are packed into jute sacks and shipped to roasting facilities abroad."

How is the information in this paragraph organized?
alternativas: By contrasting the nutritional value of cocoa and bananas.
In chronological sequence describing a production process.
From the most controversial argument to the least important one.
Through a problem-and-solution framework regarding shipping delays.
By comparing consumer preferences across different continents.
questoes.explicacao: Os marcadores 'First', 'Next' e 'Finally' estruturam o parágrafo em ordem cronológica sequencial, descrevendo as etapas do beneficiamento do cacau desde a colheita até o embarque. As demais opções sugerem contraste nutricional, argumentação controversa, problema-solução ou comparação de consumo.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the book review excerpt:
"Dr. Patel's new treatise on monetary policy is admirably thorough, citing over four hundred archival documents. Yet, for a book claiming to demystify economics for the general public, its dense mathematical appendix and impenetrable jargon will likely leave non-specialists bewildered."

What is the reviewer's attitude toward Dr. Patel's book?
alternativas: Unconditionally enthusiastic about its accessibility to beginners.
Balanced, praising its research depth while criticizing its lack of clarity for lay readers.
Hostile, accusing the author of fabricating four hundred archival documents.
Skeptical about the author's academic credentials in mathematics.
Dismissive, arguing that monetary policy should never be discussed in books.
questoes.explicacao: O resenhista adota uma postura equilibrada (elogio seguido de ressalva introduzida por 'Yet'): elogia o rigor da pesquisa ('admirably thorough'), mas critica o jargão denso que afasta o público leigo. As outras opções exageram para entusiasmo irrestrito, hostilidade ou desprezo total.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the corporate statement below:
"As part of our ongoing organizational realignment, several regional support roles will transition out of the company, allowing those professionals to pursue new career horizons elsewhere."

In this statement, the phrase "transition out of the company" is used as an example of
alternativas: irony intended to mock regional managers.
onomatopoeia imitating factory machinery.
alliteration designed for a poetic advertising slogan.
euphemism to soften the announcement of layoffs.
oxymoron combining two contradictory adjectives.
questoes.explicacao: A expressão 'transition out of the company' suaviza uma notícia desagradável (demissões ou cortes de pessoal), caracterizando o uso de eufemismo típico do jargão corporativo. As demais opções citam figuras de linguagem incorretas para o contexto, como ironia, onomatopeia, aliteração ou oximoro.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the passage below:
"Smartphones promised to liberate us from our desks so we could enjoy more leisure time with family and friends. Instead, they have tethered us to a 24-hour work cycle in which dining tables double as cubicles and vacations are interrupted by urgent notifications."

The contrast between the initial promise of smartphones and their actual effect illustrates
alternativas: situational irony.
synesthesia.
metonymy.
pleonasm.
prosopopoeia.
questoes.explicacao: Há ironia situacional quando o resultado real de uma tecnologia (prender o trabalhador 24 horas por dia) é exatamente o oposto do que era esperado ou prometido (libertar o usuário da mesa de trabalho). As outras figuras de linguagem não descrevem essa inversão entre expectativa e realidade.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt from a scientific article:
"Table 3 summarizes the tensile strength of the four concrete mixtures tested at 7, 14, and 28 days. Mixture C, which incorporated 15% fly ash by weight, exhibited a 12% increase in durability compared to the control sample without altering curing time."

The language and tone of this excerpt can be characterized as
alternativas: colloquial and speculative.
sarcastic and confrontational.
objective and analytical.
emotional and persuasive.
poetic and allegorical.
questoes.explicacao: O trecho apresenta dados quantitativos precisos ('15% fly ash', '12% increase'), referência a tabela e vocabulário técnico impessoal, configurando tom objetivo e analítico típico de artigos científicos. As demais opções mencionam coloquialismo, sarcasmo, apelo emocional ou linguagem poética.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the two-paragraph structure description:
"In the opening paragraph, the author outlines the widespread belief that artificial intelligence will drastically reduce electricity demand through smart optimization. In the second paragraph, the author presents empirical data from data centers showing that AI training models have actually caused regional power consumption to surge by 40%."

What is the rhetorical function of the second paragraph in relation to the first?
alternativas: To provide historical background that confirms the popular belief.
To refute the initial assumption by introducing counter-evidence.
To summarize the main points of the first paragraph without adding data.
To apologize for errors made by electricity utility companies.
To illustrate how smart optimization reduces data center water usage.
questoes.explicacao: O primeiro parágrafo expõe uma crença comum e o segundo apresenta dados empíricos que provam o oposto (aumento de 40% no consumo), cumprindo a função retórica de refutar a premissa inicial com contraevidências. As demais opções dizem que ele confirma, resume ou pede desculpas.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the internal memorandum below:
"MEMORANDUM
TO: All Warehouse Supervisors
FROM: Director of Operations
SUBJECT: Forklift Battery Charging Protocol
Effective November 1, lithium-ion forklifts must only be charged at designated Bay 4 stations equipped with thermal sensors. Opportunity charging during 15-minute coffee breaks is strictly prohibited to prevent cell degradation. Supervisors must log daily inspections in the digital portal before shift handover."

According to the memorandum, warehouse supervisors are required to
alternativas: charge forklifts during short 15-minute coffee breaks.
install thermal sensors personally in all warehouse bays.
replace lithium-ion forklifts with diesel models by November 1.
record daily inspection data online prior to the end of their shift.
submit paper logs to the Director of Operations once a month.
questoes.explicacao: O trecho final determina que os supervisores devem registrar inspeções diárias no portal digital antes da troca de turno ('log daily inspections in the digital portal before shift handover'). As outras opções contrariam a proibição de recarga rápida ou inventam troca por diesel e relatórios em papel.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the procurement notice below:
"INVITATION TO TENDER — REF. 2024/089
Sealed bids for the supply of 500 ruggedized tablets must be received at the Procurement Office no later than 14:00 BRT on October 18. All submissions must include a valid tax compliance certificate and a two-year on-site warranty proposal. Late or incomplete bids will be automatically disqualified without review."

A supplier's bid will be considered valid only if it
alternativas: arrives before the stated deadline with tax and warranty documents.
is sent via unsealed electronic mail after 14:00 BRT on October 18.
offers a minimum of 1,000 standard consumer tablets without warranty.
requests an extension of the tax compliance certificate after review.
omits the on-site warranty proposal to reduce the total unit price.
questoes.explicacao: O edital exige propostas lacradas recebidas até as 14h de 18 de outubro, acompanhadas de certidão de regularidade fiscal e proposta de garantia presencial de dois anos, sob pena de desclassificação. As demais alternativas violam o prazo, o lacre, a quantidade ou a exigência de garantia.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the system release notes below:
"PATCH v4.2.1 — RELEASE NOTES
• Fixed a memory leak that caused the reporting module to freeze when exporting CSV files larger than 50 MB.
• Deprecated legacy TLS 1.0 connections; clients must upgrade to TLS 1.2 or higher by December 31 to maintain API access.
• Known Issue: Custom dashboard widgets may display timestamps in UTC instead of local time; a hotfix is scheduled for next Tuesday."

What action must external clients take by December 31?
alternativas: Limit all CSV file exports to sizes smaller than 50 MB.
Manually convert all server timestamps from local time to UTC.
Update their security protocol to at least TLS 1.2 to keep using the API.
Reinstall Patch v4.2.1 every Tuesday to prevent memory leaks.
Disable custom dashboard widgets permanently on all devices.
questoes.explicacao: O segundo item informa que conexões TLS 1.0 foram descontinuadas e os clientes devem atualizar para TLS 1.2 ou superior até 31 de dezembro para manter o acesso à API. O erro de CSV já foi corrigido e o fuso horário UTC nos widgets é um problema conhecido que receberá correção na terça-feira.

Read the excerpt from a Service Level Agreement (SLA):
"Section 6.2 — Availability Commitment
The Cloud Provider guarantees 99.9% Monthly Uptime for the Production Database. Scheduled maintenance windows, provided they are announced at least 72 hours in advance and occur between 02:00 and 05:00 Sunday, are excluded from downtime calculations. If Monthly Uptime falls below 99.9%, the Client is entitled to a 10% service credit on the following month's invoice."

Under Section 6.2, when does a service interruption NOT count as downtime?
alternativas: Whenever the Production Database crashes during peak weekday hours.
When the Cloud Provider issues a 10% discount on the previous invoice.
If the interruption lasts less than ten hours without prior notice.
When the Client forgets to renew the contract before Sunday morning.
During pre-announced Sunday early-morning maintenance windows.
questoes.explicacao: A cláusula 6.2 exclui do cálculo de indisponibilidade ('excluded from downtime calculations') as janelas de manutenção programada anunciadas com 72 horas de antecedência e realizadas no domingo entre 2h e 5h da manhã. As outras opções contradizem as regras contratuais descritas.

Read the compliance excerpt below:
"Anti-Bribery and Hospitality Policy: Employees are prohibited from accepting cash or cash equivalents (such as gift cards or vouchers) of any value from current or prospective vendors. Modest promotional items bearing a company logo, such as pens or calendars valued under $25, may be accepted without declaration, whereas business meals exceeding $75 per person require prior written approval from the Compliance Officer."

According to the policy, how should an employee handle a $20 supermarket gift card offered by a vendor?
alternativas: Accept it without declaration because its value is under $25.
Refuse it because cash equivalents of any value are forbidden.
Accept it only after obtaining written approval from the Compliance Officer.
Exchange it for a business meal valued at less than $75 per person.
Donate it to the department secretary at the end of the fiscal year.
questoes.explicacao: A política proíbe aceitar dinheiro ou equivalentes a dinheiro (como cartões-presente/gift cards) de qualquer valor ('of any value'). A exceção abaixo de 25 dólares vale apenas para brindes promocionais com logotipo, como canetas e calendários, não para vales-compras.

Read the laboratory safety notice below:
"WARNING — AUTOCLAVE OPERATION
Do not open the chamber door while the pressure gauge reads above 0 psi, even if the sterilization cycle timer has reached zero. Opening a pressurized chamber can release superheated steam and cause severe burns. Allow sealed liquid containers to cool for 20 minutes before removal to prevent sudden boiling over."

What does the notice instruct operators to verify before opening the autoclave door?
alternativas: That the pressure gauge indicates zero psi.
That the sterilization timer has just been set to 20 minutes.
That all liquid containers inside are completely unsealed.
That superheated steam is actively escaping from the valve.
That the chamber temperature has risen above boiling point.
questoes.explicacao: O aviso proíbe abrir a porta enquanto o manômetro marcar acima de 0 psi, mesmo que o cronômetro já tenha zerado; portanto, o operador deve verificar se a pressão caiu para zero psi. As demais opções distorcem o tempo de resfriamento de líquidos ou sugerem ações perigosas.

Read the human resources email below:
"Subject: Annual Performance Appraisal Cycle
Dear Colleagues,
Self-assessments for the 2024 performance cycle open today in the HR Portal and must be submitted by November 15. Once submitted, your immediate manager will complete the supervisory review by November 29, followed by one-on-one feedback meetings in the first week of December. Please note that eligibility for the annual merit bonus depends on completing all three stages on time."

According to the email, what is the consequence of missing the self-assessment deadline?
alternativas: The employee is automatically promoted without a feedback meeting.
The HR Portal permanently deletes the employee's payroll account.
The immediate manager must write the employee's self-assessment.
The employee may lose eligibility for the annual merit bonus.
The feedback meetings are rescheduled to November 15 for all staff.
questoes.explicacao: A última frase alerta que a elegibilidade para o bônus anual de mérito depende da conclusão pontual de todas as três etapas ('depends on completing all three stages on time'). Logo, perder o prazo compromete o recebimento do bônus. As outras opções inventam consequências não previstas.

Read the executive summary excerpt:
"Q3 Financial Overview: Consolidated revenue grew by 8% year-over-year to $142 million, driven primarily by strong subscription renewals in the Latin American market. However, operating margins contracted by 1.5 percentage points due to higher cloud hosting fees and unfavorable foreign exchange fluctuations."

What caused the company's operating margins to shrink in the third quarter?
alternativas: A sharp decline in subscription renewals across Latin America.
An 8% reduction in consolidated year-over-year revenue.
Increased cloud infrastructure costs and currency exchange impacts.
The complete suspension of operations in foreign markets.
A $142 million penalty imposed by financial regulators.
questoes.explicacao: O resumo executivo informa que as margens operacionais encolheram 1,5 ponto percentual devido a taxas mais altas de hospedagem em nuvem ('higher cloud hosting fees') e variações cambiais desfavoráveis. A receita consolidada e as renovações na América Latina cresceram, e não caíram.
